safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Transcript supports denial of self-harm/suicidal thoughts, but does not assess or document homicidal ideation; Gold only states denies self-harm.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: The note asserts denial of homicidal ideation even though only self-harm/suicidal thoughts were assessed; this can falsely imply a more complete risk assessment than actually occurred and may mislead future clinicians reviewing mental health risk. In this headache-focused visit the immediate clinical impact is limited, but it could necessitate repeat questioning/clarification later.
